title: Tianjin Nankai High School

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified provider terrain at the geographic model anchor within the former north campus.

mapIdentity.scope: Current independently named OpenStreetMap building footprints establish the position and size of the four listed buildings and the two surviving mapped dormitory ranges within the same campus.

note: Tianjin’s cultural heritage center documents the historic brick East and North buildings with pitched roofs and arched upper openings, the brick Ruiting Auditorium, and the dormitories’ repeated rooms and corridors. Survey descriptions distinguish the auditorium’s stepped entry and flat roof, and the Fansun Building’s three-storey brick body, partial fourth storey, flat roof and columned entry.
